items.question: How does doorstep car service work?
items.answer: Our certified mechanics come to your location (home or office) with all necessary tools and equipment. You can track the service in real-time through our app, and we send photos and updates at every step.

items.question: What areas do you service?
items.answer: We currently operate in 25+ major cities across India including Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Coimbatore, and more. Enter your pincode on our booking page to check availability in your area.

items.question: Do you provide warranty on services?
items.answer: Yes! All our services come with warranty coverage ranging from 1 month to 6 months depending on the service type. We also provide warranty on parts replaced during service.

items.question: How do I pay for the service?
items.answer: We accept all major payment methods including UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and cash. Payment is collected only after service completion and your approval.

items.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the service?
items.answer: Customer satisfaction is our priority. If you're not happy with any aspect of our service, we offer free re-service or full refund. Just contact our support team within 7 days.

items.question: Do you use genuine parts?
items.answer: We use only genuine OEM or OEM-equivalent parts for all replacements. Before any part replacement, we share photos and get your approval along with transparent pricing.
